development_hold_propagation: existing GPS <=1km site single linkage on all allowed metadata including header-only coordinates
existing full-camera footprint overlap >=30% of smaller connected components on complete originals
header_only_data_role: Development site association and source-local chronological reference only; never counted as original or candidate image
footprint_model: DJI XMP gimbal yaw/pitch/roll, EXIF 35mm-equivalent diagonal focal, pinhole rays to flat ground at takeoff height using RelativeAltitude; all 4 frame corners must intersect ground within 400m; no corner clipping
footprint_error: Several-metre or larger error can occur from GPS/altitude/gimbal uncertainty, flat-ground and takeoff elevation assumptions, lens distortion, equivalent-focal conversion and ignored terrain/buildings. No georectification or common target alignment is verified.
same_date_seconds: Naive source local EXIF clock comparison only. No timezone, actual flightID or independent sortie is inferred.
nonadjacent: At least one other capture appears between source IDs in the same known camera-model/local-date metadata order; source gaps and equal-timestamp order remain uncertain.
review_components: Candidate nodes grouped by the complete registered >=30% camera-footprint graph, including links via adjacent or short-interval complete frames. The time-filtered graph is reported separately and does not establish independent groups.
first_review_priority: Cross-registered-capture-hold leads precede within-hold nonadjacent context. Distinct holds are conservative clock groups, not verified separate flights.
registered_asset_rule_not_applied: Ground-projected target outlines with 5m buffer and >=15% smaller-area intersection require target geometry; no target outlines, business annotation or asset admission were read or created.
unresolved: No physical road identity or full common target extent proven
No road presence, state equality/difference or business labels determined
No actual flight IDs or timezone verified
No independent asset or compliant genuine cross-visit pair admission
Metadata site and near-duplicate components are conservative and may merge distinct real roads
No comparison to existing CRASAR target geometry performed; only distinct source-family metadata leads counted
Whole source ZIP hash was not newly verified; per-member source CRC/size and recorded original SHA were checked
